original.target_description: Experiment 5, RMET affective theory-of-mind performance: literary fiction versus popular fiction; adjusted pairwise comparison in Table 2. Three-condition omnibus statistics are not substituted for this contrast.

n.sample_role: Participants in the literary-fiction versus popular-fiction contrast; exact analytic contrast n not established from original full text.
n.exclusions: The original full text gives N = 356 for all three conditions, including no reading; contrast-specific n and exclusion details not supplied in the retrieved main article.

p.location: Table 2, Exp. 5 RMET row and table caption; author-hosted advance publication PDF p. 6 (table corresponding to supplied locator).
p.quote: Means in the same row that share the same superscripts differ at P < 0.05.

replication.target_description: Direct replication of Experiment 5; American Mechanical Turk participants; RMET scores regressed on text condition (literary versus popular fiction), age, gender, education, and total RMET time. Condition effect is printed as a partial correlation, rather than d.

n.sample_role: Participants in the RMET regression testing literary versus popular fiction.
n.exclusions: Final general sample 300 after exclusions: repeat participation 64; incomplete 48; non-native English 10; ART outlier 1; RMET outliers 4; Yoni-trial outliers 10; short reading times 90; long reading time 1. The further difference between final sample 300 and regression n=294 is not explained.

es.location: Results, printed p. 16 (PDF p. 7); repeated Appendix 2, printed p. 21.
es.quote: Het effect van type tekst op rmet-scores was extreem klein met een partiële correlatie van .071.

p.location: Results, printed p. 16; Appendix 2, printed pp. 20–21.

reported_success.quote: the findings of this original study do not replicate in an independent study

notes: Titles verified in both paper texts. Frozen original cache contains the opening page of the assigned paper embedded with an unrelated article; retained read-only, and acquired complete author-hosted advance publication text separately. Original Table 2 prints adjusted means and a significance bound for the requested pairwise RMET contrast, but no d or contrast-specific test statistic; Table 1 omega-squared .01 and p=.04 concern the three-condition omnibus test and are not extracted as the pairwise effect. Replication prints partial r=.071 for the corresponding condition coefficient; no numerical p for that coefficient is printed. The model p=.416 is omnibus and is not substituted. The replication paper also presents reanalysed original results in its Table 1; these are not treated as statistics printed by the original authors. No metric conversion performed. The non-primary gist locator was not used.
